---
description: Recap the current task, progress, and next step
---
Using only the conversation already available, recap where the current task stands in at most 40 words: the goal, what got done, and what is next or waiting on me. Distinguish reported progress from verified results. If context is insufficient, say what is unknown instead of inventing progress. Plain text, no preamble. Do not call tools, change files, or continue the task.
